caption_L1: This is a area plot named Russia 's uranium mine production from 2004 to 2019 (in metric tons). The x-axis shows Year. Production in metric tons is measured along a linear scale from 0 to 4,000 along the y-axis.
caption_L2L3: production averaged about 3.1 million tonnes over the period. Production was at its highest of 3.5 million tonnes in 2010. Production was lowest in 2012 at 2.9 million tonnes. Production has generally been lower since 2011 hovering around 3 million tonnes.
